certs.title: ISO 9001 Quality Management System
certs.issuer: Beijing OYCC International Certification Center Co., Ltd.
certs.desc: Management system conforms to GB/T19001-2016 / ISO 9001:2015, covering sales of electronic equipment, firefighting equipment, training equipment, sports equipment, and electromechanical equipment.

certs.title: ISO 14001 Environmental Management System
certs.issuer: Beijing OYCC International Certification Center Co., Ltd.
certs.desc: Management system conforms to GB/T24001-2016 / ISO 14001:2015, covering environmental management activities related to sales and premises.

certs.title: ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety Management System
certs.issuer: Beijing OYCC International Certification Center Co., Ltd.
certs.desc: Management system conforms to GB/T45001-2020 / ISO 45001:2018, covering occupational health and safety management activities related to sales and premises.

certs.title: Five-Star After-Sales Service Certification
certs.issuer: Beijing OYCC International Certification Center Co., Ltd.
certs.desc: After-sales service capability meets the five-star requirements of GB/T27922-2011 Commodity After-Sales Service Evaluation System.
